product_metadata.title: 6-Piece Complete Plastic Blender Jar Replacement Kit Compatible with Oster Blenders

SUPERIOR MATERIALS USED – The blender jar is made from high quality and durable plastic that is perfect for any types of food you want to blend. The lid and gasket bottom cap is made from rubber for secure tight.
